seed.title: VM Provisioning Request
seed.description: Handles a virtual machine provisioning request. The agent collects VM requirements from the user, creates the VM on AWS, and shares the instance details with the user.
seed.skill:
**VM Provisioning — Collect & Create**

Use this Blueprint when a user requests a new virtual machine and its requirements need to be gathered before provisioning.

Flow: Collect VM requirements from user → Create VM on AWS → Share VM details with user → Complete.

Exits after sharing the created VM's instance details with the user.

parameters.question: What are the requirements for the VM? Please provide a name and optionally the instance type (e.g. t3.micro) and region.

properties.description: Ask the user for the VM requirements (name, instance type, region)
properties.label: Collect VM Requirements

properties.description: Create the EC2 instance on AWS with the requirements collected from the user
properties.label: Create VM

properties.description: Share the created VM details (instance ID, type, state, IPs) with the user
properties.label: Share VM Details

properties.description: Mark the VM provisioning workflow as complete
properties.label: Complete

agent.name: technical_support_agent
agent.description: A technical support agent specialized in troubleshooting issues, resolving infrastructure requests, and guiding users through technical solutions.

context.userRequest: Handle a VM provisioning request: collect the requirements, provision the machine and report back.

seed.title: VM Termination Request
seed.description: Handles a virtual machine termination request. The agent collects the instance ID from the user, confirms the termination since it is permanent, terminates the VM on AWS, and shares the result with the user.
seed.skill:
**VM Termination — Confirmation-Gated**

Use this Blueprint when a user requests VM termination and explicit confirmation is required before this irreversible action proceeds.

Flow: Collect instance ID → Confirm termination → [Not confirmed: notify cancellation, end] → Terminate VM → Share termination result.

Exits after sharing the termination result, or exits early with a cancellation notice if the user declines to confirm.

parameters.question: Which VM would you like to terminate? Please provide the instance ID (e.g. i-0abc123...) and optionally the region.

properties.description: Ask the user for the instance ID of the VM to terminate
properties.label: Collect Instance ID

parameters.question: Termination is permanent and cannot be undone. Are you sure you want to terminate this instance? (yes/no)

properties.description: Ask the user to confirm the termination since it is permanent and cannot be undone
properties.label: Confirm Termination

properties.description: Decide based on the user's confirmation whether to proceed with the termination
properties.label: Check Confirmation

properties.description: Terminate the EC2 instance on AWS with the instance ID collected from the user
properties.label: Terminate VM

properties.description: Share the termination result (instance ID, previous and current state) with the user
properties.label: Share Termination Result

properties.description: Inform the user that the termination was cancelled
properties.label: Notify Cancellation

properties.description: Mark the VM termination workflow as complete
properties.label: Complete

agent.name: technical_support_agent
agent.description: A technical support agent specialized in troubleshooting issues, resolving infrastructure requests, and guiding users through technical solutions.

context.userRequest: Handle a VM termination request: take the instance ID, confirm and terminate the machine.
